baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُدْخِلُ ... جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative entry crosses into a tree-covered interior; the same garden root can figure protection, while opened river channels and continuing flow make the interior self-renewing rather than merely enclosed.

activation_trace.role: Literal passage into an inside supplies the boundary-crossing movement into the reward.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies the sheltered habitat entered.
A protective shield sharpens the garden's enclosure into refuge rather than mere concealment.
Continuing provision makes the river flow an enduring supply system.
Opening and widening until flow occurs gives the rivers a life-making spatial action.

changed_reading.before: God rewards the believers with a pleasant garden containing rivers.
changed_reading.after: God transfers them into a protected living interior continually opened and supplied by flow from below.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse moves from intentional work to passive investiture. Wage, adornment, encircling bracelet, luminous pearl, covering dress, and silk combine so that the result of action is placed visibly on the body.

activation_trace.role: A worker's wage supplies the recompense relation between prior action and subsequent investiture.
Adornment supplies the overt act of placing honor on their bodies.
A bracelet encircling the hand makes the honor bodily and publicly visible.
Coruscating brightness makes the bestowed status perceptible rather than hidden.
Covering with clothing extends honor from discrete ornaments to the whole presented body.
Fine silk supplies the concrete texture of the final vesture.

changed_reading.before: Gold, pearls, and silk are a catalog of expensive rewards.
changed_reading.after: The wage of intended good action is materialized as a whole-body investiture of visible honor.

baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust and action opposed to corruption precede entry into an inside, while quality, adornment, purity, and dress appear outside. The scene coordinates a sound hidden state with a legible visible state.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust supply the inward condition from which the scene begins.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the reparative quality of their action.
The inward and secret aspect of entry makes interior condition part of the mechanism.
Quality or description lets adornment function as a visible characterization of the entrants.
Freedom from defect gives the silk vesture an outward image of completed soundness.

changed_reading.before: Faith and good works are admission criteria unrelated to the material scene.
changed_reading.after: The scene renders inward security and reparative action outwardly legible as an unblemished, adorned embodiment.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:14 states the same entry-garden-river promise without clothing. After 22:19-22 dresses the opposing group in fire and lets heat penetrate skin and belly, 22:23 repeats the promise and adds adornment and silk. The additions therefore answer the intervening bodily violation with a counter-vesture.

activation_trace.role: The earlier literal entry begins a nearly exact version of the focus promise before any vesture is named.
The earlier tree-covered garden fixes the repeated destination against which the focus additions stand out.
Recompense returning to its worker turns the fire garment into an embodied return parallel to the focus vesture.
Clothing and covering supply the exact bodily domain reversed by the focus silk.
Melting by heat makes the punitive material destroy bodily integrity.
Skin as the body's covering locates the damage at the boundary later reclothed.
Adornment restores the body as a site of bestowed good rather than inflicted material.
Covering with clothing provides the direct counter-garment.
Fine silk replaces destructive heat with a gentle material resting on an intact body.

structural_cues: 22:14 and 22:23 share the entry-belief-work-garden-flow sequence almost verbatim.
The fire garment, melting, iron, failed exit, and burning occupy the interval immediately before the embellished repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unembellished promise, an intervening assault on clothing and body, and an embellished repetition. I infer that the new ornaments and silk are differential repair; the live alternative is simple amplification of reward after a contrastive punishment block.

changed_reading.before: The ornaments merely elaborate an already stated garden promise.
changed_reading.after: The newly added ornaments and silk specifically repair the bodily boundary that the intervening fire garment penetrates and destroys.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposing scene pours hot water from above onto exposed heads; the focus places running rivers below the garden. Direction, temperature, and motion reverse together: assault descends from above, while life circulates steadily from below.

activation_trace.role: Pouring and downward discharge supply the violent liquid motion.
The upper direction locates the scalding liquid above vulnerable bodies.
Hot water supplies the destructive thermal quality of the descending flow.
The lower direction inverts the immediately prior flow from above.
Free running replaces inflicted pouring with ordered, continuous movement.
A river cutting the earth with flowing water supplies the beneficial lower circulation.

structural_cues: 22:19 says liquid comes from above their heads; 22:23 says rivers run from beneath the gardens.
Both scenes coordinate liquid direction with the body's material condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit opposite vertical markers and opposite liquid states. I infer a designed reversal of the material regime; the alternative is that the two conventional images are contrastive without making verticality itself meaningful.

changed_reading.before: The rivers are scenic abundance beneath the garden.
changed_reading.after: The rivers establish a reversed cosmos in which what comes from below sustains instead of what comes from above violating.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twice the surah makes delivered water activate dead or bare earth into motion, growth, and greenness. The focus joins garden, underflow, opened river, and continuing provision, turning the reward landscape into an ongoing resurrection process rather than a finished backdrop.

activation_trace.role: Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the initiating material cause of earth's revival.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the transition from stillness to animation.
Plant emergence supplies the visible product of the water-driven process.
Fresh green growth confirms the same water-to-life sequence later in the surah.
Dense, surging vegetation lets the garden register the product of continuing renewal.
Continuing provision turns the river into a maintained cause, not a static feature.
A watercourse cutting through earth supplies the channel of perpetual revival.

structural_cues: 22:5 and 22:63 explicitly sequence water, earth, and vegetative transformation.
The focus compresses that same causal set into garden plus continuously running rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated water-caused revival and the focus's permanent flow. I infer that the rivers continuously perform resurrection-like renewal inside the garden; the alternative is recurrent life imagery without a processual back-reading.

changed_reading.before: The garden is already complete and its rivers are decorative abundance.
changed_reading.after: The garden remains alive through an unending water-driven renewal that reenacts resurrection ecologically.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later moves from forced exit from dwellings, through migration and death, to God's promised entry into an entry they approve. That sequence reactivates the focus's causative entry into a sheltered garden as restored habitation after dispossession.

activation_trace.role: Passage out of an inside supplies the forced spatial loss reversed by divine entry.
Residence and attachment to a dwelling locate the loss as expulsion from home.
Movement from one abode to another extends expulsion into a migrant trajectory.
The promised pleasing entry explicitly terminates the migrant trajectory in a new inside.
The tree-covered garden gives the restored inside the character of a habitable refuge.

structural_cues: 22:59 repeats the focus root in both the act of entering and the pleasing entry-place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispossession, migration, and a divinely caused pleasing entry. I infer that the focus garden can be heard as homecoming; the alternative is that 22:59 only restates eschatological reward without making exile part of 22:23.

changed_reading.before: Entry into the garden is movement to a reward destination.
changed_reading.after: Entry is also restored dwelling: those driven out or made migrant are settled by God inside a refuge they can finally inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive adornment of 22:23 is immediately followed by two passive guidances in 22:24, first to good speech and then to a praiseworthy path. Bodily presentation, verbal expression, and movement become one bestowed mode of life.

activation_trace.role: Quality and description let bodily adornment function as a transformed manner of appearing.
Close association and habitual contact make clothing an ongoing mode, not a detached possession.
Gentle direction to truth supplies the agency that also shapes speech and movement.
Goodness opposed to corruption gives their guided speech its moral texture.
Spoken utterance extends transformed presentation from body to voice.
The straight path extends the same transformation into directed movement.

structural_cues: The passive plural يُحَلَّوْنَ is followed immediately by repeated passive plural هُدُوا.
The sequence moves from body to speech to path without changing the recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent passive transformations of appearance, speech, and path. I infer one integrated bestowed habitus; the alternative is a list of separate paradisal benefits.

changed_reading.before: Adornment is mute property added to the garden scene.
changed_reading.after: Adornment begins an integrated transformation in how the entrants appear, speak, and move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives costly visible goods to an undifferentiated plural group. The following pilgrimage section makes sacred access equal and allotted provision something eaten and actively fed to the poor. This activates the ornaments as universalized dignity rather than elite hoarding.

activation_trace.role: Adornment supplies the visible prestige whose distribution is being reread.
Gold supplies a conventionally scarce prestige material bestowed across the plural group.
Pearl supplies a second prestige good received rather than privately accumulated.
Equality between two parties supplies the adjacent principle of undifferentiated sacred access.
Allotted gift supplies a non-hoarding model of valuable provision.
Feeding another turns received provision outward toward distribution.
Material need identifies the recipient at the social edge of prestige.

structural_cues: The focus uses plural recipients and passive bestowal without ranking them.
The next section joins equal access to sacred space with commanded distribution of provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective investiture, equal access, allotted provision, and feeding the poor. I infer a redistribution of visible dignity; the live alternative is that the pilgrimage economy governs earthly food only and does not qualify paradisal luxury.

changed_reading.before: Gold, pearls, and silk reproduce the prestige of scarce private wealth.
changed_reading.after: Scarce prestige is deprivatized and bestowed across the community, making luxury an image of distributed dignity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus bracelet encircles the hand and can echo a protective wall; the surah closes with holding fast to God, whose inventory includes both protective restraint and a fixed ring on hand or neck. The ornament becomes a sign of secure attachment rather than constraint.

activation_trace.role: The literal bracelet supplies the hand-encircling object at the center of the activation.
A high surrounding wall gives the encircling object a protective perimeter image.
Protective wear extends the bracelet's perimeter into bodily security.
A hold that prevents and preserves supplies the closing relation of protection through attachment.
A fixed ring on hand or neck creates the precise material bridge back to the bracelet.

structural_cues: The focus places a ring around the hand; the final ayah commands attachment to God and names God as protector.
The closing root inventory itself joins preservation to a hand-or-neck ring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an actual bracelet, protective wear, and a closing root that combines preservation with a fixed ring. I infer that the jewelry can figure durable protective attachment; the alternative is an accidental branch-image resemblance with no inter-ayah mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The bracelet is detachable luxury placed on the hand.
changed_reading.after: The bracelet can mark a lasting bond in which encirclement no longer restrains but preserves and attaches the wearer to divine protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the freedom branch of ح ر ر through the noun for silk rather than replacing the noun's ordinary material sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by the surah's liberation and constriction vocabulary. Downstream prose should present it as contained root-play, not as a lexical translation of حَرِير.

activation_trace.role: Fine silk preserves the ordinary material anchor of the focus noun.
Freedom opposed to bondage lets the silk carry an exploratory second resonance.
Being covered with clothing turns freedom into something figuratively worn.
Release from slavery supplies an explicit surah-level liberation image.
Constriction and distress supply the condition from which the closing declaration says the religious way is free.

changed_reading.before: Silk is simply the most refined item in the entrants' clothing.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained root resonance, the entrants wear freedom itself: refined cloth becomes the bodily form of release from bondage and constriction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is strange because it links embryonic drop, pearl ornament, womb, and the garden root's fetal hiding across distant domains. It remains valid as an activation because ن ط ف explicitly carries both clear-drop/semen and pearl-ornament branches, while ج ن ن in the focus carries the hidden fetus branch. Downstream prose should call this a regenerative material analogy, not claim that garden or pearl literally means womb or semen.

activation_trace.role: A clear drop extending through semen supplies the human being's fluid beginning.
Pearl ornament and earring create the packet-internal bridge from generative drop to final jewel.
The female womb supplies the first protected chamber of formation.
The fetus hidden in the belly lets the garden root retain a chamber-of-formation resonance.
The literal pearl supplies the luminous final material in the transformation.

changed_reading.before: Pearl is one luxury object in a completed reward scene.
changed_reading.after: The mortal who began as a hidden drop is re-formed in a protected garden and bears a pearl, making reward resemble a second gestation from fluid origin to luminous completion.

strongest_changes: The exact 22:14 garden formula followed by fire garments and then repeated with new adornment makes the focus vesture an embodied repair.
Hot water poured from above in 22:19 is reversed by rivers running from below in 22:23, changing verticality from exposure to sustenance.
The surah's repeated water-to-growth sequences make the garden an ecology of continuous resurrection.
Forced exit, migration, and the pleasing entry of 22:59 make divine entry readable as homecoming after dispossession.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed both strong structural repetitions and remote branch collisions: the focus's added clothing answers an intervening bodily assault, while a closing protective hand-ring and an early drop-to-pearl branch keep stranger attachment and gestation readings alive without making them final interpretations.
remaining_uncertainties: The freedom resonance of silk and the ring resonance of holding fast are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The distributed-dignity model may be a thematic extension of pilgrimage ethics rather than a direct qualification of paradisal luxury.
The homecoming model is strongly supported for the later migrants but may not govern every member of the broader focus group.
